description: Exploit, following E004's contingency. On the current incumbent (E006: subset whitening, max-autotune compile, fp16, channels_last), widen the last group from 576 to 768 channels (128/384/768). Set epochs to 9.25 and stretch the triangular LR to match. Everything else stays fixed: lr 9.0, wd 0.012, ls 0.3, Lookahead, alternating flip, batch 1024 with drop_last. Warm up the new shapes in build. Log ms/step.
